metadata.title: General Relativity for Mathematicians - Part I
metadata.abstract: These notes cover the first part of a course of the same title taught by Filippo Fila-Robattino and Manuel Tecchiolli at the University of Zurich in the Winter Semester of 2025. Topics include variational principles in classical mechanics, special relativity, smooth manifolds and tensor calculus, connections and curvature, geodesic motion, and the derivation of Einstein's equations from the Einstein-Hilbert action. The treatment is aimed at a mathematical audience, combining physical motivation with precise definitions, detailed proofs, and explicit calculations.

analysis.workSummary: 这是一门面向数学读者的广义相对论课程第一部分讲义，整理了经典力学变分原理、狭义相对论、流形与张量、联络和曲率、测地运动，以及从 Einstein–Hilbert 作用量推导 Einstein 方程。写作强调物理动机、严格定义、证明和显式计算。
analysis.breakthrough: 为已有微分几何背景的读者提供进入相对论的连贯教材路径。
analysis.limitations: 摘要呈现的是教学材料，没有宣称新的研究定理；内容仅覆盖课程第一部分。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.35194v1 · PDF 第 2 页摘要；第 168 页 Bibliography 前说明
